long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Fairview Park, Ohio, Satullo began competing in stock cars as a young driver and achieved his signature early result at Talladega, winning an ARCA event in 1979. He also made three starts in NASCAR's top division before continuing in sports-car and club racing.

Away from the circuit, Satullo developed a parallel career as a real estate executive. He has held leadership roles across a long-running property-management group and several related investment entities, while also representing family shareholders in the sale of a ski operation. Decades after his first national starts, he returned to prominent competition in the 2025 Mustang Challenge, driving for Robert Noaker Racing and regularly finishing among the leading Dark Horse entrants.
